items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: I worked for him quite a bit in the last fifteen years of his life.

ctx.x: “Man,” he goes, “I remember you looked like you were going to explode” you know, “but man, you had some chops you know.” He goes, “I heard this kid playing a high G in the eighth grade,” and so we joke about that, you know. And Pat Williams is another one, the composer, you know. I worked for him quite a bit in the last fifteen years of his life. And I talked to him, because he was a guest artist with this youth band that I was in. Yeah, he was a guest composer, and he was also an adjudicator at the Hollywood…
full circle. It was kind of neat to be working for him actually, much, much later in life you know. Unfortunately we lost him a couple of years ago.
